_comment: UAE -> Italy waitlist registration. Inherits the shared flow from _default.json and overrides what this portal does differently.
_comment_vs_switzerland: CONFIRMED 2026-10-14: (1) checkbox HAS formcontrolname, pinned; (2) WAITLIST uses TYPED FIELDS (same as DEU/NLD), NOT passport upload — the upload is only for the booking flow; (3) NO mobile OTP step in the waitlist flow — it goes straight from summary to review-pay. Phone/email fields are disabled on the page but JS value-set fallback fills them.
_comment_enabled: CONFIRMED working 2026-10-14. Ref ITD128931344738, fee AED 38.30. Login OTP via email image (OpenAI), no mobile OTP for waitlist.
_comment_fields_2026_10_26: THE 2026-10-14 WALK UNDER-COUNTED THE FORM. Your Details has TEN mandatory fields, not seven: Gender, Date Of Birth and Passport Expiry Date were absent from this config, so Save left the form sitting there with three required controls unset and the next step's gate timed out reporting 'page never showed Summary' — which read as a gate problem and was not one. All three are now listed. Evidence: runs/6adefa72d46083/20261026_111640_ITA_waitlist_your_details_filled.png. The three new fields have NOT been through a successful live walk; confirm with `python -m src.waitlist doctor --route AE-ITA --walk` before trusting them.
_comment_checkbox: Pinned, unlike Switzerland: this portal DOES bind the control, and a named control beats inferring one from position or wording. The label reads 'Currently No slots are available for selected category, please confirm waitlist'.

fields.name: gender
fields.label: Gender
fields._comment: ADDED 2026-10-26. Mandatory on this portal and previously MISSING, which is why Save never produced a summary: the form held with 'Gender*' unset and details_summary timed out on a page that was still Your Details. Confirmed present in the 11:16 capture (runs/6adefa72d46083/20261026_111640_ITA_waitlist_your_details_filled.png), rendering as a mat-select showing 'Select'.
fields._comment_exact: "exact": true IS LOAD-BEARING — 'Male' is a substring of 'Female', and option matching is otherwise a case-insensitive substring taking .first. See the same note on AE-CZE.
fields._comment_options: NOT HARVESTED for this portal — deliberately no "options" key, so the API reports options_status="unknown" rather than rejecting a valid value against a guessed list. AE-CZE observed Female / Male / Not Specified / Others / Transgender; do not copy that here without reading Italy's own overlay. Harvest with `python -m src.waitlist doctor --route AE-ITA --walk --harvest`.

fields.name: date_of_birth
fields.label: Date Of Birth
fields._comment: ADDED 2026-10-26, same reason as gender. Addressed by LABEL, not by id: unlike Passport Expiry Date this portal family gives the DOB picker no stable id, and the AE-FRA booking walk (config/booking/AE-FRA.json) confirmed label matching resolves it on this exact two-per-row layout.
fields._comment_format: dd/mm/yyyy, as every other route in this family sends. The client file stores date_of_birth as ISO (YYYY-MM-DD) and the |date: filter reformats it. The placeholder only reads 'Please select the date', so if the input rejects this, change the filter here — not fields.py.

fields.name: passport_expiry
fields._comment_selector: PINNED BY ID, as on every other route in this family: the ngbDatepicker carries a real id, 'passportExpirtyDate', WITH VFS'S OWN TYPO ('Expirty'). Do not 'fix' the spelling.

steps.name: details_summary
steps._comment: Inherited from _default; restated only to document that this portal behaves the same way — the URL stays on /your-details and the content swaps to a summary.

steps.name: otp
steps._comment_position: POSITION MATTERS: this page sits between the details summary and /review-pay. Without "after" a new step is appended, which would put it AFTER the committing step and it would never be reached.
steps._comment_DISABLED: NOT IMPLEMENTED YET. This step needs a human-in-the-loop OTP relay: the code goes to the registered MOBILE, so it cannot be read from the login mailbox the way otp_flow.py reads the sign-in code. Planned as a Telegram round trip (bot asks -> you reply -> bot types it). Until that exists this step is disabled and the route is "enabled": false, so nothing can half-run into it.
steps._comment_page: Sits between the details summary and /review-pay. Shows a 'Generate OTP' button; clicking it sends the code and reveals an OTP input (type=password, maxlength=6) plus a Verify button, then Continue. 'Regenerate one-time password' is available, limited to 3 attempts before VFS logs the session off — so retries must be counted carefully.
steps._comment_shape: Recorded now so the implementation has a target to fill in:

steps.name: review_pay
steps._comment_timeout: 5 minutes: the OTP step before this is disabled, so the user handles it manually in the browser (Generate OTP -> type code -> Verify -> Continue). The bot polls for /review-pay and picks up automatically.
steps._comment: Identical in shape to Switzerland's, including the duplicate-id problem: several boxes share 'mat-mdc-checkbox-1'. Matched by wording, not position.

fields.name: accept_terms
fields.label: I accept the
fields._comment: Terms and Conditions consent. Its <label> wraps an <a target='_blank'> to the T&Cs — clicking the label's centre opens that link instead of ticking, which is why fields.py targets the native input first.

fields.name: agree_waitlist
fields.label: Yes, I agree for waitlist confirmation
fields._comment: Unique wording, so no index — this keeps working if VFS reorders the consents. Note the on-page text ends with a full stop ('...confirmation.'); the match is a case-insensitive SUBSTRING, so omitting it is intentional and more robust.

confirmation._comment: CONFIRMED 2026-10-14: headline 'Your Appointment is Waitlisted', receipt page with ref ITD128931344738, fee AED 38.30, Home button.
